h1: Dornbracht bathroom installation on Wentworth Estate

hero.intro: Wentworth Estate's private, gated roads mean every visit is coordinated with the estate and, where relevant, a managing agent before we're on site — a logistics step that has nothing to do with the bathroom itself, but matters just as much as the fitting when the programme depends on it running without delay at the gate. Once we are on site, Dornbracht brassware needs the same care anywhere else: it's a German brassware house known for sculptural handle and spout design, in finishes that are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere, and a scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish or a rough-in set a few millimetres out is far more visible — and far more expensive to put right — than the same mistake on a mainstream product. We fit Dornbracht fit-only on Wentworth Estate, from £3,500, coordinating access so the brassware goes in without the finish or the programme being put at risk.

sections.heading: Coordinating access before coordinating the fit
sections.body: Wentworth Estate, the private, gated estate built around Wentworth Club and its golf courses, home of the BMW PGA Championship, requires every delivery and every visit to be arranged with the estate and any managing agent in advance. For a Dornbracht installation, that means timing the delivery of delicate, design-led brassware so it isn't left waiting at a gate or handled more times than necessary before it reaches site — a detail we plan at survey stage, around 15 to 20 minutes from our Bracknell base. That planning covers who signs for a delivery, where it's staged once it clears the gate, and how it's moved into the property, so a boxed Dornbracht consignment isn't sitting outside any longer than the estate's own access arrangements require.

sections.heading: What Dornbracht brings to a Wentworth Estate bathroom
sections.body: Dornbracht's sculptural handle and spout design — across taps, mixers and shower valves — suits the scale and specification level typical on Wentworth Estate, where the brassware is often chosen to be a visible feature of the room rather than a purely functional fitting. Finishes that are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere are part of the appeal, but they're also the reason the fitting margin is smaller than on a mainstream brand.

sections.heading: Protecting the finish once it's on site
sections.body: A scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish, or a rough-in valve set a few millimetres out of position, is far more visible and far more expensive to correct than the same mistake on a standard product. On a Wentworth Estate installation, that means confirming rough-in dimensions against the Dornbracht spec before first fix, and fitting the finished brassware as late in the programme as the sequencing allows, once the risk of knocks from other trades has passed.

sections.heading: Fit-only, from £3,500
sections.body: We install luxury, fit-only bathrooms on Wentworth Estate: you source the sanitaryware, brassware, tiles and furniture, including any Dornbracht specification, and we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag, from £3,500, coordinating access with the estate so the programme runs without delay. A £125 survey comes first, and with 30 years' experience we plan both the fitting and the gate logistics together, not as separate problems.

faqs.q: Do you coordinate access through the Wentworth Estate gate yourselves?
faqs.a: Yes — we arrange deliveries and visits with the estate and any managing agent in advance, so the programme runs without delay at the gate.

faqs.q: How far is Wentworth Estate from your Bracknell base?
Is Dornbracht brassware harder to fit than a mainstream brand on Wentworth Estate?
faqs.a: The plumbing itself isn't harder, but the margin for error is smaller — a scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish or a rough-in set a few millimetres out is far more visible and costlier to correct.

faqs.q: Do I buy the Dornbracht brassware, or do you supply it as part of the job?
faqs.a: You source it. We work fit-only, so the product is yours to choose and buy, and we handle the installation, from £3,500.

faqs.q: What if a Dornbracht fitting needs a repair after we move in?
faqs.a: We offer repairs from £200, with a £500 minimum emergency call-out. We don't offer standalone regrouting.

image.heroPrompt: Purpose: hero image for the Install My Bathroom Dornbracht x Wentworth Estate installer page, a close fixture shot implying the brand through a basin tap detail. Subject and action: a close mid shot of a sculptural tall single-lever basin mixer tap mounted on a freestanding stone-topped vanity unit, a few scattered water droplets on the basin surface from a recently finished test run, no motion. Setting and work-stage: a finished principal bathroom in a substantial Wentworth Estate house, daytime, soft natural light diffused through a translucent blind. Composition: close three-quarter angle on the tap and basin rim, vanity stone surface extending into soft focus at the edges of frame. Light and materials: dark anthracite stone vanity top, brushed bronze brassware finish, soft diffused daylight with gentle uneven falloff across the stone. Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no brand names visible on fixtures, no LED strip lighting anywhere in frame, no twin symmetrical basins, no uniform gold colour wash, no plants, florals or candles as props, no water shown actively running, varied believable sheen on the stone with faint realistic water spotting rather than uniform gloss.
